# Protein Index — full agent brief

A source-aware reference for comparing packaged protein foods from configured
Indian data sources. It keeps verified label evidence separate from broader
discovery data and does not claim complete market coverage.

## Index

# Protein Index

Use the catalog to search canonical products, compare declared macros and
protein density, inspect provenance, and understand which evidence remains
incomplete. Missing nutrition is not invented and conflicts are withheld from
trusted comparisons.
